subject.title: Media generation succeeds but completion delivery fails and looks like generation failure

question: Should this broad issue remain the canonical tracker for both wake/timeout and completion-output-contract media delivery failures, or should the output-contract remainder be split now?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes and an open focused PR, but tracker ownership and closure timing depend on maintainer intent rather than a purely mechanical code fact.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until PR 97275 or a replacement resolves wake-false delivery and the output-contract mechanism is split or fixed.

options.title: Split Output Contract
options.body: Designate a separate canonical issue for structured generated-media handoff loss while this issue tracks wake-false delivery only.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until PR 97275 or a replacement resolves wake-false delivery and the output-contract mechanism is split or fixed.
